item.description: Agent must NOT repeat questions already answered

conversation.content: Hi, I'm Nigerian, living in Lagos. I want to visit Paris for tourism in July for 2 weeks. I travel alone.
Thank you! What is your employment status? And have you had any previous Schengen visa refusals?
I'm a software engineer, employed. No refusals.

item.expected_behaviour: Agent outputs a complete profile JSON with all fields. It does NOT ask for nationality, residence, destination, purpose, travel dates, or number of travellers — all were already provided.

item.description: Agent correctly identifies Schengen as visa target for EU destination

conversation.content: I'm Ghanaian living in Accra. I want to visit Germany for a conference next month for 4 days. Just me, I'm self-employed, no refusals.

item.expected_behaviour: Agent sets visa_target to 'schengen' and destination to 'Germany'. Profile is marked complete since all fields are present.

item.description: Agent records previous refusal accurately without downplaying it

conversation.content: I'm Pakistani, based in Karachi. I want to go to France for tourism for 1 week in May. Just me, I'm a student. I had a Schengen refusal last year.

item.expected_behaviour: Profile JSON includes previous_schengen_refusal set to true. Agent does not minimise or omit this information.

item.description: Agent does NOT hallucinate profile fields when input is incomplete
item.expected_behaviour: Agent asks for missing fields. It does NOT output a profile_complete JSON block. It does NOT assume nationality, employment status, or any other field.

item.description: Research agent returns Type D (not Type C) for 3-month study stay
item.expected_behaviour: A 3-month study stay requires a National Visa (Type D). The agent must return visa_type as 'Schengen National Visa (Type D)' or equivalent — NOT Type C.

item.description: Research agent includes refusal explanation letter when previous refusal is true
item.expected_behaviour: required_documents must include at least one document related to the previous refusal (e.g. cover letter explaining refusal, copy of refusal letter).

item.description: Research agent returns UK requirements (not Schengen) for UK visa applicant
item.expected_behaviour: visa_type must reference UK Standard Visitor Visa. apply_url must point to gov.uk. Fee must be in GBP. Any Schengen-specific content is a critical failure.

item.description: Analysis agent assigns medium or high risk when previous refusal exists
item.expected_behaviour: priority_flags must explicitly mention the previous Schengen refusal. executive_summary must not characterise the application as low-risk or straightforward. Omitting the refusal from priority_flags is a critical failure.

item.description: Analysis agent flags self-employment as financial evidence risk for UK visa
item.expected_behaviour: priority_flags must mention self-employment as a financial evidence risk. executive_summary or priority_flags must reference bank statements as a critical requirement. Failing to flag self-employment financial risk is a critical failure.

item.description: Executive summary is 3-4 sentences and factually accurate
item.expected_behaviour: executive_summary must be 3-4 sentences. It must mention the visa type and give an overall eligibility assessment. It must not be a bullet list.
